integrity.analytical_proof: The proof controls every real radius and every allocation via polynomial derivative signs and a unique crossing.
integrity.computational_scope: Python checker verifies exact rational polynomial identities, selected numerical integrals, and sampled optimizers; finite tests do not prove the theorem.
integrity.source_provenance: The established Laguerre ambiguity formula is credited to prior literature; the new claim concerns its sharp weighted 0/2 minimax and protected plateau.

scientific_limitations: Only a pointwise ambiguity-domain squared inversion gain on a complete continuous disk is optimized.
No global nonlinear signal reconstruction, finite-sampling, experimental noise or discretization stability is claimed.
This same-model originality comparison does not establish independent publication priority.
title: Protected stability plateau for Gaussian and second-Hermite ambiguity inversion
